info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Gap Analysis Reporting API
info.description: The Gap Analysis Reporting API provides insights into discrepancies between current banking models and targeted expectations. By leveraging this API, developers can obtain detailed reports highlighting gaps in financial services, allowing organizations to make informed decisions. This API is typically used by analysts, financial institutions, and product managers to evaluate performance and strategize improvements. Users can access specific gap analysis reports using unique identifiers, enabling tailored assessments and proactive management of banking products.

get.summary: Retrieve details for a specific gap analysis model.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the detailed information regarding a particular gap analysis identified by its unique resource ID. It is essential for understanding the nuances of the model and its implications on business processes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve gap analysis data for a specific model, identified by the unique identifier RES-100045. The structure of the request body is dictated by the schema defined for this operation.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the gap analysis model data.
